question: Trace exact Recon drone versus Lancet deployment and payload sources.

control.description: Release M433 ADS recoil amount 0.6695, GS_HK433 f32 at 1084.

sourceFacts.conclusion: WB_Drone root selects object 9; its firing object 11 selects primary Shot object 3, which selects local object 2 and VEH_Drone. A separate object 12 selects local object 1 and VB_VEH_Drone_Payload. Alternate branch activation is unresolved.

VEH_Drone selects body object 1 and local blast object 22. Mapped source values are InnerBlastRadius 1, BlastDamage 0, BlastRadius 5, ShockwaveDamage 1, ShockwaveRadius 15. These are destruction-source values, not health or payload damage. Object 15 imports the gameplay root.
VEH_Drone_Gameplay pinned root was inspected for selected health/damage ownership. No exact semantic mapping was established in this bounded pass; no numeric health, speed or range claim is made.

Lancet_WB primary firing Shot imports PD_9x19mm. Separate fields on objects 5, 19 and 44 import VE_LANCET. The bullet Shot must not be labelled the Lancet explosion payload. Deployment branch activation is unresolved.
PBNS_LancetExplosion selects body object 1 and local Class_9966532d blast object 3. Mapped source values are InnerBlastRadius 1, BlastDamage 25, BlastRadius 4, ShockwaveDamage 1, ShockwaveRadius 7.5.
Feature_Lancet imports SimEx_Lancet_TrackAndDestroy. Its object 5 constant-table element 16 imports the exact PBNS_LancetExplosion root. This does not prove a compiled-resource spawn call.

VB_VEH_Drone_Payload Shot object 3 imports PSB_PRJ_Bomb_DronePayload exported body object 1. Its own vehicle blast object 36 has the same five mapped source values as VEH_Drone; do not confuse vehicle destruction with the bomb payload.
SimEx_Lancet_TrackAndDestroy constant-table element 16 imports PBNS_LancetExplosion; expression execution and exact consumer are unresolved.
VE_LANCET exact root GUID matches all three scoped WB deployment/view imports. No exact selected health/damage owner mapping was established.

PSB_PRJ_Bomb_DronePayload selected body object 1 selects local Class_9966532d blast object 7. Mapped values are InnerBlastRadius 1.5, BlastDamage 100, BlastRadius 5, ShockwaveDamage 1, ShockwaveRadius 7.5.

inference: FIELD_MAP and L153 provide the five exact Class_9966532d blast labels; no health/speed/range labels are transferred.
Recon vehicle destruction, alternate payload bomb and Lancet explosion are different source owners.
unresolved: Current multiplayer availability and equippability are not established by captured source presence.
No runtime activation, compiled Lancet spawn consumer, units, falloff composition or effective damage formula is established.
Health, speed and operating range require exact selected semantic mappings; none are claimed.
The alternate PayloadDrone branch is not proven to be the active recon-drone configuration.
Lancet WB primary bullet selection and vehicle deployment/view selection are distinct.
Decode warnings remain; exact local class keys and descriptor fields were used only for retained selected pointers and five mapped blast fields.
siteImpact: Source-only comparison. No site edit or health/speed/range number is justified. Conditional future rows can show labelled source blast values only, with distinct vehicle destruction and payload columns and unresolved selection/runtime notes.
